Record Class VisionPoseEstimate

java.lang.Object
java.lang.Record
yall.results.VisionPoseEstimate
Record Components:
cameraName - Name of the camera that produced the estimate.
pose - Estimated robot pose on the field, in WPILib blue-origin field coordinates.
timestampSeconds - When the image was captured, on the Timer.getMonotonicTimestamp() timebase.
tagIds - IDs of the AprilTags used.
averageTagDistanceMeters - Average distance from the camera to the tags used.
ambiguity - Pose ambiguity of a single-tag estimate, 0 to 1. 0 for multi-tag estimates, and Double.NaN if the camera doesn't report it.
headingAssisted - Whether the estimate used the robot heading from VisionCamera.setRobotOrientation(Rotation3d, AngularVelocity), so its rotation is that heading rather than the camera's.
stdDevs - Standard deviations of x (meters), y (meters) and heading (radians) for PoseEstimator.addVisionMeasurement(Pose2d, double, Matrix). Filled in by the VisionPoseFilter.
public record VisionPoseEstimate(String cameraName, Pose3d pose, double timestampSeconds, List<Integer> tagIds, double averageTagDistanceMeters, double ambiguity, boolean headingAssisted, Matrix<N3,N1> stdDevs) extends Record
A robot pose estimated from AprilTags, ready for a WPILib pose estimator.

      public static VisionPoseEstimate unfiltered(String cameraName, Pose3d pose, double timestampSeconds, List<Integer> tagIds, double averageTagDistanceMeters, double ambiguity, boolean headingAssisted)
      Creates an estimate whose standard deviations the filter hasn't filled in yet.
      Parameters:
      cameraName - Name of the camera.
      pose - Estimated robot pose.
      timestampSeconds - Capture timestamp.
      tagIds - IDs of the AprilTags used.
      averageTagDistanceMeters - Average distance to the tags used.
      ambiguity - Single-tag ambiguity, 0 for multi-tag, NaN if unknown.
      headingAssisted - Whether the robot heading was used.
      Returns:
      The estimate, with zero standard deviations.
